notes.title: TRANSFORMERS: Galactic Trials | OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The time has come to roll out! 🎉Race with iconic AUTOBOTS and DECEPTICONS including Optimus Prime, Bumblebee, Megatron and Soundwave, in TRANSFORMERS: Galactic Trials, out now on PC, Xbox, Playstation and Nintendo Switch 🎮

Experience unique hybrid gameplay in this racing adventure game with rogue-lite elements! Play solo in the Galactic Trials and collect 70 Prime Relics to level-up speed, damage and handling, or challenge a friend in Arcade Mode with 2-player local multiplayer. Fans can also keep a look-out for Easter Eggs inspired by the entire 40 year history of the TRANSFORMERS franchise! 🚗🤖

notes.title: TRANSFORMERS: Galactic Trials
notes.content:
Get ready for an electrifying fusion of arcade racing and robot combat with TRANSFORMERS: Galactic Trials, coming this October! 🤖🚗 

Choose your loyalty by playing as iconic AUTOBOTS or DECEPTICONS including Bumblebee, Megatron and Optimus Prime, and collect the stolen Prime Relics across the tracks to unlock new skills. Make it to the finish line by racing around 10 battle-race circuits in both vehicle and bot form, beating enemies along the way in exciting rogue-lite combat! 🎉 🎮 

Find out more 👉 https://outrightgames.com/us/games/transformers-galactic-trials/
